title: SWF: emit CWS (zlib-compressed) output; wire 'Compress movie' publish setting
description:
Completed. Summary of changes:

1. packages/swf/src/compile.ts: Fixed zlib format - changed deflateSync (raw deflate) to zlibSync (proper zlib format with 78 9c magic header) since SWF CWS requires RFC 1950 zlib format, not raw RFC 1951 deflate.

2. packages/swf/src/export.ts: exportSWF() now defaults to compress: true (CWS), matching Flash 8 'Compress movie' default. Callers can pass { compress: false } to get FWS.

3. packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx: Changed initial publishSettings compress: false → compress: true.

4. packages/authoring-ui/src/PublishSettingsDialog.tsx: Changed DEFAULT_PROFILE_SETTINGS compress: false → compress: true.

5. tools/golden-report.mjs: Now passes { compress: true } when calling compileDocument to match the publish path. Self-determinism PASS, 0 tag-count mismatches.

6. packages/swf/src/__tests__/compress.test.ts: Updated inflateSync → unzlibSync (fflate) to handle zlib-wrapped body; added tests 9-12 for exportSWF default compression.

7. packages/swf/src/__tests__/publishopts.test.ts: Updated inflateSync → unzlibSync.

8. Multiple test files (bgcolorlabel, charids, clipactions, clipactions_impl, e2e-compile, instancename, placeobject2, export): Added { compress: false } to exportSWF() calls that parse raw SWF bytes for tag inspection.

Results:
- golden-report: SELF-DETERMINISM PASS, 0 tag-count mismatches
- All tests pass: @flash/swf (107 files), @flash/core (320 files), @flash/authoring-ui (36 files)
- Default publish output starts with 0x43 0x57 0x53 (CWS)
- golden.fla compiled size: 3185B (CWS) vs 5734B golden reference
- Compress toggle round-trips: compress: false → FWS, compress: true (default) → CWS
